"An utterly miserable day": Kempton Park meeting marred by death of three horses

The Lanzarote Hurdle card at Kempton Park was marred by the death of three horses, including the Grade One-winning Kalif Du Berlais, whose loss Paul Nicholls described as "a big kick in the teeth" and a "sad day."

Kalif Du Berlais - whose ownership group includes Sir Alex Ferguson - unseated Harry Cobden in the four-runner Coral Silviniaco Conti Chase and landed lame, with the broken shoulder he sustained proving untreatable and he was euthanised by the veterinary team on Saturday.

Nicholls said: "It's a sad day when you lose horses like that, it's hard on the whole team. It's a big kick in the teeth for everyone, the owners, the poor girl who looks after him - you hate to see that happen. He was just showing his class today, he jumped and travelled well and sadly now he will never be able to show the potential we thought he had.

"I can say as much as I like, but it's just a shame for the whole team. Harry was extremely upset and is missing his ride in the last as he doesn't feel great about it. He's a big, bold horse who attacks his fences and those horses, when they do that, can end up having a bad fall.

"He was enthusiastic today and travelling beautifully and we'll never know where we would have ended up, we've always had a lot of faith in him. These things happen, sadly, and we'll have to try to pick ourselves up and move forward. These horses get the best of everything, there's not much you can say to make it better at this point.

"It never gets any easier when these things happen and it's a big old blow."

In the Coral Daily Rewards Shaker Handicap Chase, Jonjo and AJ O'Neill's Peso was pulled up on the flat with an injury that could not be treated, leaving racecourse vets with no choice but to euthanise him.

Harry Derham saddled Wertpol for the juvenile hurdle and the horse looked to be running a huge race before falling at the last and sustaining a life-ending injury. Derham said on his X account: "An utterly miserable day at Kempton Park today losing Wertpol who we only had the good fortune of having in our yard for a short period of time.

"It's a sad day when you lose horses like that, it's hard on the whole team. It's a big kick in the teeth for everyone," said Paul Nicholls. Photograph: Alan Crowhurst/Getty Images

"He was a bright talent who was fresh and happy doing his work every day, often playing around and expressing himself. He loved his job and I am so sad for his Heart Of The South syndicate, who are the most wonderful group of people. Racing can at times be a painful sport and today has been a tough day for a number of connections. A day to forget."

A spokesperson for Kempton Park said: "All of us at Kempton Park care deeply about the welfare of all racehorses, as do the thousands of racing staff who provide them with world-class levels of care at home every day. Our heartfelt condolences are with the connections of all three horses."

hypothesis:
“Aivve surgadis beaivi”: Kempton Parka gilvvut surgadedduis golmma heastta jápmimiin

Kempton Parka Lanzarote Hurdle -gilvoprográmma surgadii golmma heastta jápmin. Okta dain lei Grade One -vuoiti Kalif Du Berlais, man manahallama Paul Nicholls govaidii “garrasit deaddilin” ja “surgadis beaivin”.

Kalif Du Berlais – man oamasteaddjijoavkku searvvis lea maid Sir Alex Ferguson – bálkii Harry Cobdena selggistis Coral Silviniaco Conti Chase -gilvvus, mas ledje njeallje heastta. Heasta gahčai ja šattai gárbun, ja dan doddjon oalgi lei nu fasti, ahte dálkkodeapmi lei veadjemeahttun, ja šibitdoavtterjoavku fertii luitit dan sisa lávvardaga.

Nicholls muitalii: “Lea surgadis beaivi go dakkár heasttat manahallojuvvojit, dat lea lossa ášši olles jovkui. Dat lea garrasit deaddilin buohkaide: oamasteaddjiide, sutnje geas heasttas lea fuolla – ii dakkár dáhpáhusaid háliidivčče goasge oaidnit. Son čájehii aiddo iežas dási odne, njuikii ja ruohtai bures, ja šállošahtti dál son ii goasge beasa čájehit iežas dakkár potensiála mii mis lei dárkkuhus.

"Sáhtán lohkat vaikko maid, muhto dat lea dušše šállošahtti olles jovkui. Harry lei hui unnistuvvan ja son ii riide maŋimuš gilvvus, go son ii dovdda iežas bures dán geažil. Dat lea stuorra ja duostilis heasta, mii áidigoarkŋun-gilvvuin manná njuolga áiddiid vuostá, ja dakkár heasttaide sáhttá dasto gártat lossa gahččan.

"Son lei odne movttet ja ruohtai čábbát, eatge mii goasge dieđe gosa livččiimet gártan. Mis lea álo leamaš garra jáhkku sutnje. Dát áššit dáhpáhuvvet, šállošahtti, ja mii fertet geahččalit dál njuorrat ja ovdánit. Dát heasttat ožžot buot buoremusa, ii dás dál leat olu maid sáhttá lohkat mii dán ášši buoridivččii.

"Ii dat goasge álggut go dát dáhpáhuvvá, ja dat lea stuorra časkestat.”

Coral Daily Rewards Shaker Handicap Chase -gilvvus Jonjo ja AJ O'Neilla Peso bissehuvvui duolbba eatnamis bákčasiid geažil maid ii sáhttán dálkkodit, mii gáibidii gilvvošaddit šibitdoaktariid luitit dan sisa.

Harry Derham riidii Wertpola nuoraid áidegilvui, ja heasta orui riidejit hui bures ovdalgo son gahčai maŋimuš áiddi nalde ja oaččui dakkár bákčasa mii loahpahii su eallima. Derham čálii iežas X-konttus: “Aivve surgadis beaivi Kempton Parkas odne go manahallat Wertpola, gean mis lei lihkku doallat iežamet šiljus dušše oanehis áiggi.

“Lea surgadis beaivi go dakkár heasttat manahallojuvvojit, dat lea lossa ášši olles jovkui. Dat lea garrasit deaddilin buohkaide,” Paul Nicholls dajai. Govva: Alan Crowhurst/Getty Images

"Heasta lei šaddáris taleanta, mii lei varas ja lihkolaš iežas barggus juohke beaivve, ja dávjá stođai ja čájehii iežas movtta. Son humai iežas barggu, ja lean hui lossadit su Heart Of The South -syndikáhta beales, mii lea buot eanemus ipmárduslaš joavku. Gilvvut sáhttet muhtumin leat bákčasat ja odne lea leamaš lossa beaivi máŋgga oamasteaddjái. Beaivi mii ferte vajálduhttojuvvot.”

Kempton Parka ovddasteaddji muitalii: “Mii buohkat Kempton Parkas beroštit hui garrasit buot gilvvoheasttaid čálggus, nu mo maid dat duháhollat gilvvohallit geat biddjot sidjiide máilmmi dási fuola ruovttus juohke beaivve. Mii sáhttit váimmolaš lossadit buot golmma heastta oamasteaddjiide.”

Reading Gloria Steinem's undercover report on being a Playboy Bunny... finished Part I and damn🤔
Despite being well aware of Playboy being uh... a CORPORATION lol... had no idea how much their entire infrastructure truly served to perpetuate classism in an extremely creepy way while outwardly presenting themselves as the "classy" and thus "more ethical" option compared to say, Hustler

I'll post some screenshots later but to give you the gist, Bunnies (who were cocktail waitresses), had to:
- accept lower (by $200-150, equivalent to today's $2.5K) wages than advertised
- hand over 50% of all their tips
- give their last names to "Number 1 key holders" (ergo, celebrities/elites) if asked
- be subjected to a pelvic exam and blood test but weren't allowed to pick the physician
- be spied on by a private eye
- go out if their way to hide their husbands/bfs

The central point that unites all of this:
Bunnies were STRICTLY NOT ALLOWED TO (penalized by termination) date any other employees or customers... BUT accompanying and dating the "Number 1 key holders" was permitted, if not encouraged. See where this is going?

New recruits were given a "Bunny Bible" to study all those bizarre rules and instructions from.
To mention a few more:
- Bunnies' work performance was assessed by a "merit system" (YES, that exact wording!) instead of being written up. Unsurprisingly, merit was not only judged by a good work ethic but also very specific requirements on looks and attitude.
- there was an incentive system in place that rewarded Bunnies who sold the most liquor and merchandise

Local stable out to cash in at Coffs with four contenders

Local trainer Noel Mayfield-Smith is hoping to have a lucrative day at Sunday's Coffs Harbour meeting with four runners stepping out for the stable on the six-race card.

The Group 1-winning horseman will start his day in the second event of the day when Ausbred Yahoo contests the Komatsu Country Boosted Benchmark 58 Handicap (1605m) with two-kilogram claiming apprentice Ella Drew taking the ride.

Racing returns to Coffs Harbour on Sunday.

Ausbred Yahoo has been racing in good form with a third placing at Kempsey three starts ago being followed by two successive seconds at Coffs Harbour, the latest when beaten by Sunday's rival Caledonian.

Mayfield-Smith links with another apprentice, three-kilogram claimer Leanne Boyd, when Never Island starts in the Insurance Advisernet Australia Pink Silks F&M Benchmark 58 Handicap (1305m).

A winner of three of her 15 starts, Never Island will carry 59.5 kilograms after Boyd's allowance. Never Island was beaten less than a length when second behind Montgomery at Grafton and backed that up with a last-start fifth at Coffs Harbour behind In The Fine Print when again beaten less than a length.

Raymond Spokes takes the ride on the Mayfield-Smith-prepared Monte Cruise in the O'Brien Plumbing Relining Wayne Glenn Pink Silks Cup Benchmark 82 Handicap (1205m).

Monte Cruise is also a three-time winner from just the nine starts. She hasn't raced since July when finishing last of eight at Eagle Farm and has had two trials at this track in preparation for her return, finishing second behind Saturday's Wyong winner Petticoat before winning the latest of them.

Mayfield-Smith rounds out the day when he again links with Boyd when she rides Cardsharp in the Key Community Group C,G&E Benchmark 58 Handicap (1305m).

Báikkálaš stállu háliida bures dienadit Coffsas njeallji gilvaleaddjiin

Báikkálaš hárjeheaddji Noel Mayfield-Smith doaivá, ahte sotnabeaivvi Coffs Harboura gilvobeaivvi sus šaddá buorre dienáhus, go njeallje su stállu heastta oassálastet guhtta-gilvosaš prográmmas.

Joavku 1-vuittihan heastaolbmo beaivi álggaha beaivvi nuppi gilvvus, go Ausbred Yahoo gilvu Komatsu Country Boosted Benchmark 58 Handicap-gilvui (1605 m), mas guokte kilo geasseoasi ožžon oahppovuodji Ella Drew vuodjá.

Heasttagilvut máhccet Coffs Harbourii sotnabeaivvi.

Ausbred Yahoo lea gilván buori hámiin: golbma álggu dás ovdal son lei goalmmát Kempsey:s, ja dan maŋŋel son lea leamaš guokte maŋŋálagaš nubbin Coffs Harbour:s, maŋimuš geardde go vuollánai sotnabeaivvi vuosttálažžanii Caledoniani.

Mayfield-Smith bargá maiddái ovttas eará oahppovuodjiin, golbma kilo geasseoasi ožžon Leanne Boydain, go Never Island álgá Insurance Advisernet Australia Pink Silks F&M Benchmark 58 Handicap-gilvvus (1305 m).

Never Island lea vuoitán golbma iežas 15 álggus, ja Boyd geasseoasi maŋŋel son guodda 59,5 kilo. Grafton:s Never Island lei nubbin Montgomery maŋis ja vuollánai unnit go ovtta heastaguhkkodaga. Dan maŋŋel son lei viđát maŋimuš álggus Coffs Harbour:s In The Fine Print maŋis, fas vuollánan unnit go ovtta heastaguhkkodaga.

Raymond Spokes vuodjá Mayfield-Smitha hárjehan Monte Cruise O'Brien Plumbing Relining Wayne Glenn Pink Silks Cup Benchmark 82 Handicap-gilvvus (1205 m).

Monte Cruise lea maiddái golbma geardde vuoiti dušše ovcci álggus. Son ii leat gilván suoidnemánu rájes, go son lei maŋimuš gávcci heastta gaskkas Eagle Farm:s, ja son lea máhcadeami ovdal leamaš guovtti geahččalangilvosis dán gilvobanas. Son lei nubbin laurdde Wyong-vuoiti Petticoat maŋis ovdal go vuittii maŋimuš geahččalangilvvuin.

Mayfield-Smith loahpaha beaivvi go son fas bargá ovttas Boydain, guhte vuodjá Cardsharp Key Community Group C,G&E Benchmark 58 Handicap-gilvvus (1305 m).

The Cloudhorizon Waterproof feels purpose-built for the stop-start rhythm of winter commuting. Its lightweight waterproof upper keeps your feet dry without adding bulk, and the shoe's smooth rocker shape helps you roll forward easily, even when you're layered up and carrying heavy loads.

Underfoot, Helion foam creates a cushioned bounce that softens long walks between stations, while the grippy rubber outsole keeps things steady on wet steps and shiny tiles. The pared-back design gives it a polished, modern look, ideal if you prefer a trainer that handles lousy weather subtly, without shouting its technical credentials.

source_doc:
On a lighter note, just saw someone complaining about when games beg you to switch to easy mode when you fail.
I also hate this.
I love having an easy mode. Hell, I think games should just fuckin' let you cheat, as long as competitions all have agreed-on rules about it.
But every game that's pestered me into easy mode has been an instant put-down. I have plenty of games to play, if you want me to be done faster, congrats, I'm done faster.

This is what makes modern Marios - modern-ish anyway - so impossible for me to play.
"Did you die thwee times mawwio? Here's the golden supersuit of invincibility because you suck! If you don't want it, just carefully avoid ever pressing anything besides "start level yes again no no nothing else just start the level".
This is also why I stopped trying to play Phantom Pain. Whenever I died, it'd offer me the chicken hat and default to "yes", eventually I forgot to manually say "fuck off".

I get it's a retention thing, but it's so disrespectful.
Autoscaling difficulty also pisses me off, because I'll be gearing up for a challenge and then the game will panic and lower it to super easy because I've been "struggling".
I'll die or something, go back to try again, but nope, now the challenge is gone. You succeeded! You made the game go away! Don't worry, those challenges were for someone else. Someone better.
I can't remember if I ever completed a game with autoscaling difficulty.

I guess the basic difference between me and their target audience is that I like to figure out how to do something, while their target audience - at least in their heads - likes to take a log flume through a Disneyworld attraction.
A little jostling, a little fluids, but don't worry, baby, daddy Walt's got ya. You're safey-wafe, you don't even have to move, just sit there and tee hee, here's a wittle splashy-splash.
If I wanted that, I'd go sit in a fucking dog park and pet a dog.

Somibut áššiide, oidnen juste muhtuma váidaleamen dan birra go spealut rávget du speallat álkkes dásis go it lihkostuva.
Mun maid vašuhan dán.
Mus lea hui buorre go gávdno álkkes dássi. Dorjo, mu mielas spealut livčče galgan diktit du juoba behttit, gohan gilvvuin leat ovttamielalaš njuolggadusat dan birra.
Muhto juohke speallu mii lea ávžžuhan mu álkkes dásis lea dakkaviđe bálcestuvvon eret. Mus leat doarvái spealut speallat, ja jos háliidat mu válmmeštit jođáneappot, lihku, lean válmmas jođáneappot.

Dán dihte lea dálá Mario-spealuid – dálá-láganid goitge – nu veadjemeahttun speallat munnje.
"Jámihit go golbma geardde Mawwio? Dá lea golle-superbivttas mii dahká du immortálan go leat nu heittot! Jos it háliit dán, de váruhit deaddilemes eará go "álggah dási jo fas ii ii eai eará mieldde dušše álggah dási".
Dán dihte heiten maid geahččaleames speallat Phantom Pain. Go jámmijin, de fálai munnje vuonccáháhta ja dálai "jo", gieđat-gieđat vajálduhtten dadjat "vuošša gáfe".

Ipmirdan ahte dat lea speallit-bisuhan-ášši, muhto dat lea nu badjelgeahčči.
Automáhtalaš váttisvuođadási mudden maid fasttoha mu, go mun lean ráhkkaneamen hástalussii ja de speallu fasttioda ja vuolidit dan spealu badjelmearálaš álkkes dásis go lean "ráhčan".
Mun jáman dahje juoidá, manan fas geahččalit, muhto ii, dál lea hástalus eret. Lihkostuvve! Divtte spealu jávkat! Ale mureh, dat hástalusat ledje earáide. Muhtumii gii lea buoret.
In muhte leango goassege geargan spealuin mas lea automáhtalaš váttisvuođadási mudden.

Iggastan ahte dat vuođđomuttu earru mu ja sin ulbmeljoavkku gaskkas lea ahte mun liikon gávdnat vuogi dahkat juoidá, muhto sin ulbmeljoavku – goitge sin mielas – liiko váldit muorrariidda-vádjoleami Disneyworld dajahusas.

Jos háliidivččen dan, de manan čohkkát beatnatpárkii ja bajit beatnaga.

Progress after a while off. I got the sewing machine out to do the bill and a crown seam. Half the crown sewn plus the bill, resting atop the paper form made from the pattern. I had to rip and re-sew the machine stitch because I pinned along instead of across the seam and went off track. I might re-do the bill if I want a little more depth.
#millinery

Eight crown panels and two bill panels assembled into three pieces and pinned for general shape. Sachi's Studio Newsboy Cap pattern in green velvet. Mostly machine stitched.
The pattern calls for topstitching along the seams of the crown panels, which might suggest either matching or contrasting thread.
#millinery

Top view before I sew the crown halves together. Reviewing the how-to video. I see Sachi is using a few tiny spring clips during sewing instead of pinning the whole seam.

A bit of a messy join on the eight panels coming together at the peak of the newsboy cap, so I am thinking a larger button may be in order to disguise the seams.

Crown fully pieced, with cloth covered.button at peak. Raw edges loosely tucked under. Seams neither pressed nor topstitched.
#millinery

and it's not a bad film — it's a spectacular-looking one in spots — but it is also a film entirely made out of other, better and more thematically cohesive films. so it's 2001 and the three-body problem and arrival and wall-e a little bit, but it's also Quips Sexyman Saves The World Part XVII and ultimately just not that lot

while watching i wondered why the earth needed to be in peril, and if the other two members of the multicultural crew dying to leave the White Man in charge was some kind of an anti-woke statement; but in light of some of the book author andy weir's 'most media literate libertarian' comments about how star trek should be just about spaceships going pew-pew, at least to him the answer is yes to the latter and 'fascism' to the former

@esvrld I read the book a little while back and I may have given him too much credit, especially given his recent decision to open his mouth, but I took the death of the international crew to strand the white boy as an understanding that his second book failed because he is not any good at writing people interacting with each other and his only skill is creating clever little puzzles for his self-insert to solve in complete isolation. Giving him an alien buddy was a good move because it opens the possibility of character interaction without requiring it to resemble the way humans relate to one another

The hosts took the lead in the 26th minute via the prolific Diaz as the Real Madrid player showed his scoring instinct.

Achraf Hakimi's corner was headed goalwards by Ayoub El Kaabi and Diaz deflected the ball in from close range.

He has now scored in each of Morocco's five games and extends his own record for most goals by a Moroccan at a single Cup of Nations finals, but left the field late on with a heavily strapped thigh that will be a concern for coach Walid Regragui.

Chances were hard to come by for both sides, but Abde Ezzalzouli headed narrowly over the crossbar from another Hakimi corner, while the latter laid on a headed chance for Saibari that was spurned.

Cameroon were unfortunate not to get a penalty kick when Mbeumo was caught in the box as Mauritanian referee Dahane Beida waved play on, while Georges-Kevin Nkoudou headed wide at the back post with the Indomitable Lions' best chance of the game.

Morocco made it 2-0 minutes later to kill off the contest when Saibari was left unmarked at the back post and had time to control the ball and fire low into the far corner of the net.

Ismael Saibari gave Morocco breathing space against Cameroon (REUTERS)

In Friday's other quarter-final, Iliman Ndiaye scored the only goal as Senegal booked an Afcon semi-final berth for the third time in the last four tournaments, beating 10-man Mali 1-0.

Ndiaye netted after 27 minutes, taking advantage of a goalkeeping howler to put Senegal ahead in a tense derby against their west African neighbours.

Mali were reduced to 10 men for the second half after captain Yves Bissouma was sent off for a second caution on the stroke of halftime.

He was booked first for a clumsy challenge in the 25th minute and was dismissed after a needless foul on Idrissa Gana Gueye.

Mali were down to 10 men from the 26th minute of their previous clash against Tunisia and still managed to squeeze through on penalties but there was no recovery this time around against a polished Senegalese outfit.

project move out, spring break relay
day 1:
Cleared main bedroom closet
& contents of boxes on one wall.
I'm surveying all my belongings. Pulling out a small percentage to save. Sentimental items. Practical pieces for putting together a new life. At this stage I know I'm selecting more than I need, probably more than I can carry; but the amount that I'm leaving behind is far greater. Deciding what to keep & where comes after the survey. All the rest will be turned over to "scavengers."
#moverR

Day 2, midday break, Monday.
Today is harder than yesterday. I'm uncovering far more "sentimental" stuff. The challenge: these saved memories are a physical drag that impair rather than contribute anything practically to my future AND I feel integrated looking at them. There's a strong general condemnation, I feel, of holding onto sentimental items. Yet I know that they are powerful. But hey, I'm an artist. Even wistful, sad memories are valuable to me. I'm proceeding as before, retaining less+

+than I'm tossing, while knowing that I am keeping "too much." The next phase will be the actual moving & storing phase when more might be cut. This phase is the pre-screen before turning the cleared items over to others who will take everything away.
File under: how to move out of a home of 12 years & a home town of 45 years, with family roots here (& artifacts) from 150 years. I'm finally leaving, in search of a culture that suits my values.
#moverR

Tinkering with my stereo system this week has got me thinking about an oddity that I've never been able to get to the bottom of...let's see if the Mastodon hive mine can help.
The amp is a Philips FA454 and the CD Player is a Philips CD150.
According to the amp manual I can connect the units with a "8-pole DIN to 5-pole DIN + 2 x single-pole CINCH" cable."
I take this to mean an 8 pin din to a 5 pin + stereo RCA cable...which sounds cursed.
Never been able to find one. Can anyone make one?

The service manual for the amp is nice and clear (picture 2 in above toot), but I can't find anything as nice for the CD player. I've attached a picture (picture 4 in the above toot) from the service manual that I *think* is the relevant section.
Currently I have the CD player hooked up with just the RCA cables and it all works fine, but if I could find/make the correct Din to Din + RCA cable then I could use some additional functionality and free up the only RCA stereo inputs on my amp.

There's a repair café this weekend in the town where I live...if I'm still puzzling over it all by then I might take it all along there and see if they can help me hack together a cable.

source_doc:
Celtic hammer Dundee United on O'Neill's return

Normal service resumed at Celtic Park as champions Celtic secured a dominant 4-0 win over Dundee United and their first clean sheet since Martin O'Neill's previous game in charge.

Two first-half goals in five minutes from Yang Hyun-jun and Arne Engels sent Celtic on their way as O'Neill returned to the dugout in style following Wilfried Nancy's brief but disastrous reign.

Substitute Benjamin Nygren grabbed his 11th goal of the season and Daizen Maeda netted on the rebound to equal Celtic's two biggest wins of the league season so far. Both of them were in O'Neill's caretaker spell in charge, which resulted in seven wins from eight games.

Celtic sent for the 73-year-old on Monday after terminating Nancy's contract in the wake of six defeats - and 18 goals against - in eight matches.

The chaos, confusion and defensive fragility that marked Nancy's reign disappeared as the Hoops moved three points off the top of the table.

Nobody in the stadium would have been surprised to see O'Neill restore Celtic's long-standing 4-3-3 formation and the team picked up where they left off under O'Neill, as if they had awoken from a nightmare and got on with life as normal.

Centre-back Liam Scales was back to the consistent form he displayed before suffering in and out of a back three under the Frenchman.

Callum McGregor dictated play again and Celtic's wide players, Yang and Sebastian Tounekti, were given attacking licence after being handed wing-back roles by the former Columbus Crew head coach.

Celtic enjoyed 78 per cent possession, had 22 shots at goal and let United have just three. Their opponents averaged 12 shots during Nancy's tenure and United managed 17 themselves during their 2-1 win over the Hoops at Tannadice less than four weeks ago.

Celtic penned United in from the start, with Kieran Tierney instrumental in creating a series of first-half chances.

The left-back had a shot deflected wide, Yang and Scales threatened from headers and Maeda flicked a low cross of the bar, before the pressure paid off in the 27th minute.

Such was Celtic's dominance that Scales found himself in possession on the edge of the box and rolled a pass to Yang, who drilled home from 20 yards.

Maeda soon mis-kicked a volley before Engels produced a first-time finish from Tierney's pass.

It was not all plain sailing for Celtic in the first half. Mexican right-back Julian Araujo marked his first start with a yellow card for a dangerous challenge on Will Ferry, who was still hobbling when he took the resulting free-kick.

United also had chances and Dario Naamo looked unsure whether to head or volley Craig Sibbald's deep cross and did neither and Owen Stirton twice came close.

The striker was firstly foiled by a goal-saving block from Scales after being gifted possession by Auston Trusty and later shot just wide from 18 yards after the Celtic central defence backed off.

United brought on winger Amar Fatah for holding midfielder Pan Camara at half-time but Celtic were even more dominant in the second half.

Reo Hatate and Maeda missed good chances before Nygren shot high into the net from six yards in the 63rd minute.

Maeda had an easy finish six minutes later after Tounekti's shot was saved.

hypothesis:
Celtic deaddilii Dundee Uniteda O'Neill máhccama oktavuođas

Dábálaš ortnet máhcai ruovttoluotta Celtic Parkii, go measttar Celtic válddii vuođđuduvvan 4–0-vuoittu Dundee Uniteda badjel ja seailluhii vuosttaš geardde málakeahttá Martin O'Neill ovddit mátčči rájes geasseheaddjin.

Guokte vuosttaš beali máli viđa minuhta siste Yang Hyun-jun:s ja Arne Engels:s bidje Celtica buori johtui, go O'Neill máhcai geasseheaddjebensii čeahpes vuogi mielde Wilfried Nancy oanehis muhto heađuštaddan áigodaga maŋŋel.

Lonuhuvvon Benjamin Nygren dahkai iežas 11. máli dán áigodagas, ja Daizen Maeda časkii málui ruovttoluotta boahtán báli, nu ahte Celtic olahii dássásaš stuorámus liigavuoittu guokte geardde dán áigodagas. Goappašat bohte O'Neill gaskaboddosaš geasseheaddjiáigodagas, mii buktái čieža vuoitto gávcci mátčis.

Celtic bivdii 73-jahkásačča vuossárgga maŋŋel, go Nancy kontrákta loahpahuvvui guhtta vuolláibáhcima ja 18 vuostámála maŋŋel gávcci mátčis.

Seavdnjadasvuohta, eahpečielggasvuohta ja hearkkes suodjalan, mat Nancy áigodaga mearkkašedje, jávke go Hoops sirddii iežas golbma poengga lahkoseabbot tabealla čohkii.

Ii oktage stadionas livčče imaštallan O'Neill máhcahan Celtic guhkesáigásaš 4–3–3-ráhkadusa, ja lihtti joatkkii doppe gos dat lei báhcán su vuolde, dego speallárat livčče musihis nieggus bohccon ja joatkkán eallima dábálaččat.

Guovddášsuodjaleaddji Liam Scales lei ruovttoluotta dássemaš buori hámis, man son čájehii ovdal go váttástuvai fránskalačča vuolde golmma suodjaleaddji linjjás.

Callum McGregor stivrii spealu ođđasit, ja Celtic olgguldasspeallárat Yang ja Sebastian Tounekti ožžo ruššenfriddjavuođa maŋŋel go ovddeš Columbus Crew váldogeasseheaddji lei bidjan sudno wing-back rollaide.

Celtic hálddašii báli 78 proseantta áiggi, skuvlii 22 geardde málaguvlui ja attii Unitedii dušše golbma skuvlla. Nancy áigodagas su vuostásaččat gaskamearit skuvle 12 geardde, ja United ieš skuvlii 17 geardde go dat vuittii Hoops 2–1 Tannadices unnit go njeallje vahkku dás ovdal.

Celtic deaddilii Uniteda álggu rájes, ja Kieran Tierney lei hui dehálaš ráhkadit máŋga vejolašvuođa vuosttaš bealis.

Gurutbeallisuodjaleaddji skuvla njulgejuvvui olggobeallái, Yang ja Scales uhkidii oaivečaskkamiiguin, ja Maeda stierai vuollegaš ruosskabáhči badjel rasta, ovdal go deaddo mávssii 27. minuhtas.

Celtic badjelmearrádus lei nu stuoris ahte Scales gávnnai iežas báliin ruosskáguovllu ravddas ja rollii syöhta Yangii, guhte časkkii nanus ruoktot 20 yards:is.

Maeda boasttut deaivvadii volleya árrat, ovdal go Engels loahpahii Tierney syöhta vuosttaš guoskamiin málui.

Ii buot mannan álkit Celticii vuosttaš bealis. Mehikolaš olgešbeallisuodjaleaddji Julian Araujo oaččui fiscada váralaš duššemis Will Ferry vuostá iežas vuosttaš álggahusas, ja Ferry vel lonuhallai go časkii dan čuovvovaš friijasčaskama.

Unitedis ledje maiddái vejolašvuođat, ja Dario Naamo orui eahpevissisin ahte galgago son oaivviin vai volleya časkit Craig Sibbald guhkes ruosskabáhči, muhto ii dahkan goappáge, ja Owen Stirton lei guovtte geardde lahka.

Vuosttažettiin Scales eastadii su skuvlla mállegáhttema blokka maŋŋel go Auston Trusty attii sutnje báli, ja maŋŋil son skuvlii dušše veahá olggobeallái 18 yards:is go Celtic guovddášsuodjalan geassánii maŋos.

United lonuhii bealleaiggis olgguldasspeallára Amar Fatah čadnon gaskaguovddáš Pan Camara sadjái, muhto Celtic lei vel eanet badjelmearrádus nuppi bealis.

Reo Hatate ja Maeda hukse buori vejolašvuođaid, ovdal go Nygren skuvllii báli alás fierpmái guhtta yards:is 63. minuhtas.

Maeda oaččui álki loahpahusa guhtta minuhta maŋŋel, go Tounekti skuvla vurkejuvvui.

I've never seen Jessica do so much chores at home.
You're right.
I think I literally do like, two weeks worth of dishes.
The one day I'm here, but I'm always like, tells me that I can't leave the dishes in the sink.
Can't leave my stuff in the sink.
I'm so diligent here.

In a surprise Inspector Clouseau twist, I now have an extra thing to investigate for Spooky Kitties Sciences!
I was doing a quick scroll through the evenings secondary camera video, when I spotted a curious The Inspector standing on the trunk of the tree near the feeding station. Kept jumping around, finding him near where the magpies had been, so I initially suspect(edit) he was simply chasing them as they sometimes let him do, until I randomly chance stop...
#SpookyKittiesSciences

There Inspector Clouseau was, rolling around like crazing about 2 meters NE of the tree, mostly hidden by the unfortunate placement of the awnings east post. Still, there he was for 5 minutes, at which point he ran back up the tree, walked across the lawn to the hill, flattened himself at the bottom, and then ran off camera, presumably in the middle of The Zoomies.
2/
#SpookyKittiesSciences

Now, as some of my Spooky Kitties Sciences readers may know, the motivations behind that tests are not just to entertain the kitties. While the most important aspect is the genuine curiosity I had seeing the kitties rolling around in the snow, I really wanted to find something that The Inspector liked. I came out of the initial testing with only a single moment to hint that he liked something. What that was is still a mystery.
3/
#SpookyKittiesSciences

Ate a little more chicken and had a wash. Also had a little more fight when I made her take her fluids last.
We phoned the vet at 830 this morning to ask if they looked under her soft pallet while she was sedated, as she has major ear polyps. Was told the vet would call back. They didn't, rang just now (1645 local) and was told the vet wasn't in today. I was a bit annoyed and said "we paid you over £600 yesterday, you said phone if we have questions, we have questions you're not answering!"
"I don't like your tone, sir "
"It's not your fault personally, but when I pay the better part of a grand I expect a level of service that you're not providing"
"I'll get a vet from the other branch to ring you"

Seeing vet at other practise at half seven for more anti nausea medicine. They're not going to charge out of hours rate as we rang first thing.
Just got another 10ml of rescue fluids into her.

Back. Anti nausea jab, gabapentin, and she's home. Ate some chicken and some cheese.
Got more gabapentin in pill form for her, too

Won't stop eating. Having to slow her down to prevent her from vomiting. She's also absolutely, completely, totally, off her tits. Mullered. Stoned. Caned. Fully in the yellow submarine.
Vet says this'll reset her appetite, or, when we stop giving her painkillers, show it's pain stopping her eating, which would mean medical imaging time.

She's eating a bit, and even played a little, but she's still on the medications so it might be that. Still giving her recovery fluids, which she's still not fighting as she would normally.

Valencia has decided we are all Suspicious. Won't come when called, runs if you go to her. Still comes on her own terms, so it's fine, she's just seen her adoptive sister repeatedly wrapped in a towel and made to drink Stuff, and she wants none of that, thank you very much.

Ming update: she's a little more active, but still floppy and sleeping a lot. She's on two lots of painkillers still, so she's probably fairly stoned.
She IS eating, little and often, and finished off the last of her rescue fluids from a saucer by herself. She's washing, but she hasn't slapped valencia in ages, and she's still not right. Hoping it's the painkillers, and that when we withdraw them, her appetite remains.

Ming has finished the course of painkillers and is showing determined desire to go out, which we're not allowing yet. She's eating, playing, but it'll be a few days until the drugs are cleared from her system and we'll then see how she is.
Cautiously optimistic.

Borai fas veahá eanet vuonccavuoššala ja basadii. Lei maiddái veahá eanet vuostálastinmoddus go bággejin su juhkat gárvvesčázi maŋimusat.
Mii riŋgiimet elledálkkodeaddjái dán iđit dihto 8:30 ja jearaimet geahčadedje go sii su litna giergaga vuollái go son lei ráfáiduhttojuvvon, go sus leat dakkár stuorra bealljepolypat. Sii lohke ahte elledálkkodeaddji riŋge ruovttoluotta. Eai riŋgen, riŋgiimet aiddo dál (báikkálaš áiggi 16:45) ja guliimet ahte dálkkodeaddji ii leat dás odne. Ledjen veahá moaráš ja dadden "mii máksiimet didjiide badjel 600 lihtte-ruvnno ikte, dii lohkašeiddet ahte galgat riŋget juos leat jearaldagat, mis leat jearaldagat maidda ehpet vástid!"
"Ii liiko du jietna, hearra"
"Ii dat leat persovnnalaččat du sáhka, muhto go máksá measta duhát lihtte-ruvnno de vuordá dakkár bálvalusdási maid ehpet fála"
"Bággen nubbi bálgá dálkkodeaddji riŋget dutnje"

Oaidnalit dálkkodeaddji nubbi bálgás beal gávcci áigge oažžut eanet dálkasa vuovssi vuostá. Eai áiggo váldit liigemávssu go riŋgiimet dakkaviđe iđđes.
Ožžon vel 10ml gárvvesčázi sutnje sisa.

Ruovttoluotta. Moari-boahkuheapmi, gabapentin, ja son lea ruovttus. Borai veahá vuonccavuoššala ja veahá vuosttá.
Ožžon eanet gabapentina pillarahámis sutnje maiddái

Ii bisse borramis. Fertet su gohcit giddet vai ii vuovssat. Son lea maiddái áibbas, ollislaččat, dievaslaččat, jalla-mielas. Áibbas gárren. Duolvvas. Gievrras gárrenmoddus. Áibbas fiskes čázevulošfanas dás dál.
Elledálkkodeaddji lohká ahte dát galgá ordnet su borranlusttu, dahje go loahpahetne bákčas-dálkasiid, de čájeha ahte bávččas lea dat mii eastá su borramis, mii fas mearkkašivččii ahte fertet dálkkodeaddji govaide.

Borada veahá, ja spealai veahá maiddái, muhto lea dál vel dálkasiid mielde nu ahte soaitá dat mii váikkuha. Vel addimin sutnje gárvvesčázi, man vuostá ii velge vástalut nu go dábálaččat dahká.

Valencia lea mearridan ahte mii leat buohkat eahpárassii dakkárat. Ii boađe go gohčču, gárgá juos manná su lusa. Boahtá vel go ieš hálida, nu ahte dat lea buorre, lea aiddo oaidnán iežas adoptiiva-oappá fáhtejuvvon liidni sisa máŋgii ja bággejuvvon juhkat Juonid, ja ii hálit dakkár dál ollige, giitu goitge ollu.

Ming-diehtu: son lea veahá eanet lihkadeamis, muhto lea velge splatnja ja oađđá ollu. Sus leat dál guokte sierranas bákčas-dálkasa, nu ahte lea kánske veahá jalla-mielas vel.
Son BORÁ goitge, veahá ja dávjá, ja gearggahii ieš gárvvesčázi man mii leat bidjan tallearkka ala sutnje. Basada, muhto ii leat Valencia jorggiidan dábálaččat guhká, ja ii leat velge áibbas buorre. Sávašeimme ahte dat leat bákčas-dálkasat, ja ahte go stopteat daid, de borranlustu báhcá.

Ming lea geargan bákčas-dálkasiiguin ja čájeha dál gievrras dátu mannat olggos, maid mii eat vel divtte. Son borá, spealla, muhto dása manná moadde beaivvi ovdal go dálkasat leat eret su rumaš-vuogádagas ja de oaidnit mo son lea.
Várrogas optimistilaš.

source_doc:
This morning while walking to work I had a thought: is it possible that the reason why the perception of the #replyGuy problem being worse on #Mastodon (and the #Fediverse in general) is due to sheer (lack of) numbers?
So I came up with a simplified model to check if this was indeed sufficient to explain the phenomenon.
Let's assume that, similarly to Mario Cipolla's Basic Laws of Human Stupidity, the fraction of reply guys in a population is a given constant ρ.
1/n
#maths

Let's also assume for simplicity that reply guys operate mechanically, i.e. do not use some kind of automation to find posts to reply to. This puts an upper limit to the total number of posts a reply guy can reply to in the course of a single day. Let's call this D.
We can also assume that on average a single non-reply-guy will generally post P < D posts per day.
Ignoring for a moment larger timeframes than a single day (but the discussion is similar if we extend the observation period) …
2/n

 … and assuming replyguys select randomly the posts to reply to (i.e. they don't specifically target a person for any particular reason), can we calculate what is the probability that a given person will see at least one reply from a reply guy?
Before doing the actual math, let's look at some practical example. Let's say that 1 in 10 users are reply guys, a reply guy goes through 100 posts per day, and a regular user posts 10 messages per day.
3/n

If there are 10 users in the network, 9 are regular users and 1 is a reply guy. There are 90 regular posts per day, and the the single reply guy will see ALL of them (because they can read 100 posts per day, so they see all the posts made on that network on that day.
However, if there are 100 users in the network, 10 of which are reply guys, the network will produce 900 posts in a day, but reply guys will NOT necessarily see all of them!
4/n

In the second scenario, each reply guy will see 100 random posts of the 900. Even if there are 10 reply guys, this does NOT mean that each post will be found by a reply guy! There may be posts that are seen by multiple reply guys, and posts that will not be seen by any reply guy!
So how do we compute the probability for a post to be seen by a reply guy in this case?
One way to do this is to compute the probability of NOT being seen by ANY reply guy, and taking the complement.
5/n

Now, since each reply guy sees 100 of the 900 posts, each post has a 1/9 probability of being seen by any particular reply guy, i.e. an 8/9 probability of NOT being seen by that particular reply guy. The probability of not being seen by ANY reply guy is thus 8/9 for each reply guy and assuming that the probabilities are independent, this means that the probability of not being seen by any of the 10 reply guys is (8/9)^10, which is 0.30794....
6/n

This means that the probability for each post to be seen by AT LEAST ONE reply guy is 1-(8/9)^10 or approximately 69%.
Of course, if someone posts 10 posts per day, then the probability for them to come across a reply guy is higher than that, because it will be the probability of at least on their post being seen by at least one reply guy!
Again assuming that for each post the probabilities are independent, the math is only slightly more complex:
6/n

each post has a (8/9)^10 probability of not being seen, but for the probability for ALL posts not being seen, that has to be further elevated to the number of posts made by the same person, which is 10, so (8/9)^100, and the probability of AT LEAST ONE POST being seen by AT LEAST ONE reply guys becomes 1 - (8/9)^100 = 0.99999233… which is not 100% but very close to it.
This was the case of a network 100 people, 10 of which are reply guys. Let's do one more and then go general.
7/n

Let's now assume the network has 100K users, still with the same 10% of reply guys (90K regular users, 10K reply guys).
Each reply guy still reads 100 posts per day, and the regular users still produce 10 posts per day.
This means that in a single day the regular users produce 900K posts, and each reply guys reads 100 of those 900K posts!
Still under the randomness assumption, this means that a single reply guy will only see 100/900K posts!
8/n

source_doc:
Ashley Barnes at the double as Burnley claim welcome win over Millwall

Ashley Barnes bagged a brace as Burnley put their Premier League worries on hold to cruise into the fourth round of the FA Cup with a 5-1 win over Millwall.

The 36-year-old scored his first goal of the season early on and added his second midway through the second half as the blundering Lions gifted a confident home side the most emphatic of wins.

Boss Scott Parker made eight changes to the side that started in Wednesday's 2-2 draw with Manchester United and they did not disappoint, as further goals from Loum Tchaouna and Jaidon Anthony put them out of sight by half-time.

Substitute Jaydon Banel added Burnley's fifth on the stroke of 90 minutes before the shell-shocked Lions, who had completely capitulated, netted an added-time consolation through Josh Coburn.

Burnley dominated the opening exchanges and grabbed the lead in the 11th minute when Jacob Bruun Larsen squared for Barnes to sweep home past visiting goalkeeper Steven Benda.

The Lions mustered little in response, with Aidomo Emakhu booting their best chance straight at Burnley keeper Max Weiss after being released down the left by Joe Bryan.

But the visitors slowly grew into the game and should have levelled when Jake Cooper got his head on Alfie Doughty's cross from deep on the left but was denied by a brilliant over-arm save from Weiss.

The keeper saved again from Cooper on the half-hour as Millwall threatened a leveller but the visitors were undone by two defensive errors that put the game beyond their grasp.

Tchaouna was allowed to thread his left-foot shot from the edge of the box past a static Benda on 35 minutes and shortly before the break the Millwall keeper's poor clearance ultimately gifted Anthony the chance to slide home his side's third.

Millwall looked livelier at the start of the second half and Thierno Ballo should have done better when he found space to get a shot off in the left side of the box, but the home side were clearly in cruise control.

Tchaouna came close to his second when he rifled a shot against the outside of Benda's right-hand post and the increasingly inevitable fourth arrived on 65 minutes when Kamarl Grant made a hash of clearing Anthony's right-wing cross and a delighted Barnes mopped up.

Hunting for a hat-trick, Barnes flashed a header straight at Benda as the linesman's flag was raised, but it was Banel who completed the rout from close range before Coburn's confident finish in stoppage time.

36-jahkásaš spellei skorii iežas dán baji vuosttaš moala álgomuttus ja lasihii nuppi gaskamuttus nuppi beallása, go meattáhusaid dahkan Lions attii iežassihkaris ruovttujovkui hui čielga vuoittu.

Lions ii nagodan báljo maidege vástidit, ja Aidomo Emakhu bálkii sin buoremus liibba njuolga Burnley málvahtarii Max Weissii maŋŋá go lei beassan friija gurut bealde Joe Bryana bokte.

The Case for Impeaching Donald Trump

Bombs over Latin America: It's giving Wag the Dog, if you ask me. The administration, seemingly hot to bring back neoconservative military conquest, soft-launched its latest regime change war in Venezuela by making indiscriminate attacks on boats in the Caribbean and Pacific waters off of Central America. These attacks, all undertaken without a jot of congressional oversight and on the dubious premise that the boats were packed with fentanyl bound for the United States, were murderous on their own. But the news that the military was ordered to strike an already stricken boat in a "double tap" attack to kill any survivors has raised the specter of war crimes - and in a way that even many Republicans don't seem ready to countenance.

Trump's Binance buddy gets a pardon: Changpeng Zhao began this year the disgraced former CEO of Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, having done prison time for, as the Biden DOJ put it, "failing to maintain an effective anti-money laundering (AML) program," violating the Bank Security Act, and allowing money to flow freely to a host of bad actors, including "terrorists, cybercriminals, and child abusers." But Zhao, having forfeited the right to run Binance, wanted back in. So he used his connections to Trump's family and inner circle to secure a pardon that would let him run the show again. In return, Zhao showered his attention on World Liberty Financial - using Binance's leverage to enrich Trump's private crypto fund. TNR's Tim Noah was positively apoplectic about the shady arrangement.

Chips to China: Speaking of Tim Noah and apoplexy: It's probably not great that one firm, Nvidia, has come to possess such godlike, market-moving power. Its outsize importance to the global economy had Noah fingering it as one of the major pillars to crumble, when he gamed out a potential Trump stock market crash back in October. Trump's been doing what he can to boost Nvidia's fortunes, however: This year, the president broke with long-standing national security tradition and announced that he was permitting the firm to sell its H200 chips to China. As The New York Times" David Sanger noted, the deal - the fruits of "intense lobbying" from Nvidia CEO and White House gadfly Jensen Huang - raised a basic question: "If the chips that power the most advanced technology can be sold to the United States" chief technological, military and financial competitor, where is the new line drawn?" That's probably the least of Trump's concerns, however: The deal also guaranteed that "25 percent of all the revenues from the sales would go to the United States," in yet another case of this administration's affection for fascist corporatism.

Falkirk strengthen top six hopes with away win at St Mirren

Miller then made sure of the points just after the hour mark as he capitalised on some static St Mirren defending to race on to his own blocked shot before dinking the ball over George.

It was an afternoon to forget for St Mirren, who lost Liam Donnelly, Killian Phillips and George to injury as they slipped to a third straight defeat.

Falkirk had the first opening in the 18th minute when Barney Stewart laid the ball off to Dylan Tait, whose curling effort from just outside the box took a slight deflection before cannoning off the top of the crossbar.

St Mirren finally threatened just after the half-hour mark when Mikael Mandron shot from a tight angle, forcing Falkirk goalkeeper Scott Bain into a smart stop with his feet.

Falkirk then raced down the other end and the lively Miller was released and allowed to shoot from a similar angle but George comfortably saved.

The match was finally coming to life and Dan Nlundulu was the next to fire at goal in the 36th minute after the Bairns had given up possession cheaply, but it was a routine stop at the near post by Bain.

Nlundulu then got in behind and slid the ball home, though the cheers from the home fans were short-lived as the assistant referee raised his flag for what appeared to be a clear offside.

The hosts had already lost Donnelly to injury midway through the first half and they suffered a further blow when Phillips, who appeared to hurt his shoulder in the opening period, came off at the interval.

The match was crying out for a moment of quality and it came 10 minutes into the second half through Yeats.

Tait's perfect through ball released Miller, and although George came racing out of his goal and timed his challenge well, the loose ball fell invitingly for Yeats, who curled a stunning first-time finish into the top corner of the unguarded St Mirren goal.

It got even better for the away side just after the hour mark as the Bairns doubled their lead.

Miller's initial shot from the edge of the box was blocked by Scott Tanser but, as the home defence hesitated, Miller reacted first to run on to the loose ball and lift a right-footed shot over the onrushing George.

St Mirren suffered yet another blow shortly after as the keeper was forced off to be replaced by Ryan Mullen.

The enforced changes and the quickfire goals seemed to rock the hosts and they never threatened a comeback, with their afternoon summed up in the 89th minute when Tanser completely mis-kicked his attempted volley from six yards out.

hypothesis:
Falkirk nanne bajimus guhtta searvvi gaskii beassan-doaivagiid vierusvuoitumiin St Mirrena vuostá

Diimmu mearkka maŋŋá oanehaččat Miller sihkkarasttii čuoggáid, go son ávkkástallii St Mirrena heajos suodjalusas, viežžalii iežas hehttejuvvon šuhttima čuovvut ja de čiekčanii balla George badjel.

St Mirrenii dát lei beaivi maid sii háliidedje vajáldahttit, go Liam Donnelly, Killian Phillips ja George báhce vahágiid geažil eret, ja joavku geige goalmmát geardde maŋŋálaga vuollánemii.

Falkirkis lei vuosttaš stuorra vejolašvuohta 18. minuhtas, go Barney Stewart sirddii balla Dylan Taitii, gean geavrris šuhttin ceahki olggobealde ožžoi unna rievdama ovdal go deavddui risttegoalkka bajimus oasis.

St Mirren áitet loahpas oanehaččat bealle diimmu maŋŋá, go Mikael Mandron šuhttii hui garras geahččanguovllus ja bákkui Falkirka goallevárrejeaddji Scott Baina várjalit juolggiiguin jierpmálaččat.

Falkirk viežžalii de jođánit nuppe beallái, ja čilggas Miller luoittojuvvui ovddos ja oaččui šuhttit sullasaš geahččanguovllus, muhto George várjalasttii dat álkit.

Speallu lei loahpas ealláskahttimin, ja Dan Nlundulu lei čuovvovaš gii šuhtii goalái 36. minuhtas maŋŋá go Bairns lei balla menddo álkit massán, muhto Bain várjalasttii dábálaččat lahka poasttas.

Nlundulu beasai de suodjalusa duohken ja čuikgadii balla goalii, muhto ruovttuluotta olbmuid illudančuorvut bistte eai guhkká, go veahkkeduopmár loktii lippu dan geažil, mii orui čielga offside-n sajin.

Ruovttuluotta joavku lei juo massán Donnelly vahága geažil vuosttaš beallemeari gaskamuttus, ja sii oaččo vel eanet hehttema, go Phillips, guhte orui skálžžus vahágahttán álgooasás, báhččii eret bealleáigge.

Speallu dárbbašii buori kvalitehta bottu, ja dat bođii 10 minuhta maŋŋá nube bealle álggus Yeatsa bokte.

Taita ollislaš čađačiekčan luoitii Millera, ja vaikko George viežžalii jođánit olggos goalástis ja áigudahtii iežas duššama bures, luovvanan balla bođii bures Yeatsii, guhte geavrris hui čábbát vuosttaš geardde loahpaheami bidjii várjjakeahtes St Mirrena goala bajimus čiegii.

Vierusjoavkui manai vel buorebut diimmu mearkka maŋŋá, go Bairns guovddážii ovdamunni.

Millera vuosttaš šuhttin ceahki ravddas hehttejuvvui Scott Tansera bokte, muhto go ruovttuluotta suodjalus epmádii, Miller reagereii vuosttažettiin, viežžalii luovvanan balla ja loktii olgešjuolggiin šuhttima ovdánan George badjel.

St Mirren vásihii vel ođđa lossa čuolmma oanehaččat maŋŋá, go goallevárrejeaddji fertii vuolgit ja Ryan Mullen bođii sadjái.

Bákkolaš rievdadeamit ja jođánis goalat orrojedje časkán ruovttuluotta joavkku, iige dat goassege áitet ruovttoluotta boahtit, ja sin heajos beaivi čoahkkánii 89. minuhtas, go Tanser ollásit boastut čeahkkalii iežas volley-geahččaleami guhtta jardda guovllus.

Diimmu mearkka maŋŋá oanehaččat Miller sihkkarasttii čuoggáid, go son ávkkástallii St Mirrena heajos suodjalusas, viežžalii iežas hehttejuvvon šuhttima čuovvut ja de čiekčanii balla George badjel.

St Mirrenii dát lei beaivi maid sii háliidedje vajáldahttit, go Liam Donnelly, Killian Phillips ja George báhce vahágiid geažil eret, ja joavku geige goalmmát geardde maŋŋálaga vuollánemii.

Falkirkis lei vuosttaš stuorra vejolašvuohta 18. minuhtas, go Barney Stewart sirddii balla Dylan Taitii, gean geavrris šuhttin ceahki olggobealde ožžoi unna rievdama ovdal go deavddui risttegoalkka bajimus oasis.

St Mirren áitet loahpas oanehaččat bealle diimmu maŋŋá, go Mikael Mandron šuhttii hui garras geahččanguovllus ja bákkui Falkirka goallevárrejeaddji Scott Baina várjalit juolggiiguin jierpmálaččat.

Falkirk viežžalii de jođánit nuppe beallái, ja čilggas Miller luoittojuvvui ovddos ja oaččui šuhttit sullasaš geahččanguovllus, muhto George várjalasttii dat álkit.

Speallu lei loahpas ealláskahttimin, ja Dan Nlundulu lei čuovvovaš gii šuhtii goalái 36. minuhtas maŋŋá go Bairns lei balla menddo álkit massán, muhto Bain várjalasttii dábálaččat lahka poasttas.

Nlundulu beasai de suodjalusa duohken ja čuikgadii balla goalii, muhto ruovttuluotta olbmuid illudančuorvut bistte eai guhkká, go veahkkeduopmár loktii lippu dan geažil, mii orui čielga offside-n sajin.

Ruovttuluotta joavku lei juo massán Donnelly vahága geažil vuosttaš beallemeari gaskamuttus, ja sii oaččo vel eanet hehttema, go Phillips, guhte orui skálžžus vahágahttán álgooasás, báhččii eret bealleáigge.

Speallu dárbbašii buori kvalitehta bottu, ja dat bođii 10 minuhta maŋŋá nube bealle álggus Yeatsa bokte.

Taita ollislaš čađačiekčan luoitii Millera, ja vaikko George viežžalii jođánit olggos goalástis ja áigudahtii iežas duššama bures, luovvanan balla bođii bures Yeatsii, guhte geavrris hui čábbát vuosttaš geardde loahpaheami bidjii várjjakeahtes St Mirrena goala bajimus čiegii.

Vierusjoavkui manai vel buorebut diimmu mearkka maŋŋá, go Bairns guovddážii ovdamunni.

Millera vuosttaš šuhttin ceahki ravddas hehttejuvvui Scott Tansera bokte, muhto go ruovttuluotta suodjalus epmádii, Miller reagereii vuosttažettiin, viežžalii luovvanan balla ja loktii olgešjuolggiin šuhttima ovdánan George badjel.

St Mirren vásihii vel ođđa lossa čuolmma oanehaččat maŋŋá, go goallevárrejeaddji fertii vuolgit ja Ryan Mullen bođii sadjái.

Bákkolaš rievdadeamit ja jođánis goalat orrojedje časkán ruovttuluotta joavkku, iige dat goassege áitet ruovttoluotta boahtit, ja sin heajos beaivi čoahkkánii 89. minuhtas, go Tanser ollásit boastut čeahkkalii iežas volley-geahččaleami guhtta jardda guovllus.

Tonight in #MMRPG! My back finally shuts up enough that I can GM again as the heroes continue their search for the missing girl Cammie. Vega the Digital Dragon surprises a trio of mischievous scamps who snuck into her arcade in the middle of the night but one of them recognizes her as a town superhero and they end up having a heartwarming moment geeking out over video games. Unfortunately, the moment is interrupted by somebody or something landing on the roof of the arcade... 1/?

Vega goes to investigate and finds Dr. Vesper, in his monstrous bat form that the press has dubbed the "Gargoyle Man," along with a harpy-like creature that Vesper describes as his "little protegee." Vesper says that they have come to introduce themselves and invite Vega to join their society of man-creature misfits that is led by "The Madame," Dr. Diana Laughton of the Laughton Institute. 2/?

Vega buys some time to get the mischievous scamps out of the arcade and call the rest of the Mythics for backup, then plays along at being interested in joining this "new family." Vesper and Harpy (who does not speak once during the interaction) lead Vega to a ship in the harbor, where the Laughton Institute appears to be packing up their things... presumably because they know they're drawing attention from Agent Carter and A.R.G.E.N.T. among others. 3/?

My brother in He-Who-Shall-Not-Be-Named, what you are describing is a consequence of _misogyny_, not "misandry."

I desperately need men to realize that just because it's directed at them and an actual serious problem doesn't mean it is "misandry."
Just saw someone describe being discriminated against _for being considered effeminate_ as "misandry" and I just.

It's not that you aren't experiencing something real. You very well may be. But it isn't "misandry." Because "misandry" doesn't exist.
Yes, this applies to trans men as well. "Transmisandry" _also_ isn't a thing and just contributes to anti-feminist narratives. It treats itself as a mirror of transmisogyny, but transmisogyny is _intersective_: we experience transphobia _and_ we experience misogyny _and_ we experience this unholy thing that happens when the two interact. It's not a subset, even an exclusive subset, it's an intersection.
But the following all are absolutely problems that can be talked about!
* Transphobia/Transmisia
* Antitransmasculity
* Transemasculation
* Misogyny
It sucks to be discriminated against, but the language that we use is so, so important here.

Mu viellja Sus-gii-ii-galgga-namai-mainna, dat maid don leat govvemin lea _nissonvašuheami_ bohtos, ii “almmáiavašuheapmi”.

Mun duođaid dárbbašan ahte albmát ipmirdit ahte dat go juoga čuohcá sidjiide ja lea álggosge duođalaš váttisvuohta, ii dasto mearkkaš ahte dat lea “almmáiavašuheapmi”.
Oainnán áidna easka muhtun olbmo gohčodit dan ahte son lea diskriminerejuvvon _dan geažil go su leat doallan nissonlágan_ “almmáiavašuheamen” ja mun juste.

Ii leat nu ahte don it leat vásiheamen juoidá duohta. Dat sáhttá hui bures leat nu. Muhto dat ii leat “almmáiavašuheapmi”. Danne go “almmáiavašuheapmi” ii leat mihkkege.
Juo, dát gusto transalbmáide maid. “Transalmmáiavašuheapmi” _maiddái_ ii leat mihkkege ja dušše addá fámu antifeministtalaš narratiivvaide. Dat bidjá iežas dego transmisogyniija speadjalin, muhto transmisogyniija lea _ruossasteaddji_: mii vásihit transfobiija _ja_ mii vásihit nissonvašuheami _ja_ mii vásihit dán eahpelunddolaš ášši mii šaddá go dat guokte deaivvadit. Dat ii leat vuolledoaimma, ii juobe dakkár erenoamáš vuolledoaimma, dat lea ruossastan.
Muhto čuovvovaččat leat buohkat duođaid váttisvuođat maid sáhttá hupmat birra!
* Transfobiija/Transmisia
* Antitransmaskulinitehta
* Transemaskuleren
* Nissonvašuheapmi
Lea hirbmat go diskriminerejuvvo, muhto giella maid mii geavahit dáppe lea hui, hui dehálaš.

source_doc:
And being one of the weirdo, we just frequently get attacks here and there. Either online, offline, or even from your closest people. Those attacks usually stem from homophobia, transphobia, or sometimes just, don't like how weird we are and how weird we act, especially furries that do deeper immersions like roleplaying and therianthropy.

Hence some of us got safety by not needing to tell who we are and where we were from. Some of us got safety by only revealing ourselves to our friends or close friends. Face/body reveal is a culture that most of the furries did at least once in a private post, whether it be "delete soon" kind of post or in story.

Despite being so, we're still open for social interactions offline. We do furmeets—a personal meeting between furries, be it in a group or personal, be it in an event or just casually—and sometimes making a con/fur on, such as MWFF, IWAG, PAWAI, FURUM, and so on. It's fun to meet them offline, get to know each other, be able to see them in person as most of us have never seen each other's faces, take a photo to keep personally and censor publicly, laugh together and discuss similar interests, and so on. It's fun, social, and warm.

Although, things don't feel the same today. As people start trying to strip anonymity of people, attack furries, therian, LGBTQIA, and dox them, as how also our community participate and stir the dramas inside, things has been a little more chaotic, less warm, and less feeling like community or family. It's not the same anymore.

Part of me hopes things can return to how it feels in the 2000s and 2010s, but, I'll just let God do the rest. I'm a little hopeless in society and humans. I'm tired of how things get worse and meant to attack and divide small communities into a hopeless being. I don't like how society is now no longer respecting and being in unity.

Ja go mii leat dakkár imašlaččat, de mii juste oažžut fallehemiid dákko ja duokko hui dávjá. Juogo neahtas, lunddolaš eallimis, dahje vel iežat lagamus olbmuin. Dat falleheamit bohte dábálaččat homofobiijas, transfobiijas, dahje muhtumin juste das go eai liiko man imašlaččat mii leat ja movt mii láhttet, erenoamážit furrit geat ellet dán eallinvuohkái čiekŋaleabbot, nugo rollaspealuiguin ja therianthropy-vugiin.

Dan dihte muhtumat mis ožžo oadjebasvuođa go eai dárbbashan muitalit geat mii leat ja gostat mii leat eret. Muhtumat mis ožžo oadjebasvuođa go čájehit iežamet dušše iežamet ustibiidda dahje lagaš ustibiidda. Ámadaju dahje goruda čájeheapmi lea kultuvra maid eanas furrit dahke unnimustá oktii priváhta postas, lea dasto dakkár "sihkkon farga" -stilla postas dahje muitalusas.

Vaikko lea ná, mii leat dattetge rabas sosiála deaivvadeamiide neahta olggobealde. Mii ordnet furmeet-deaivvadeami—persovnnalaš deaivvadeapmi furriid gaskka, lea dasto joavkkus dahje guovttá gaskka, dáhpáhusas dahje juste dábálaččat—ja muhtumin ordnet con-dahje fur-deaivvadeami, nugo MWFF, IWAG, PAWAI, FURUM ja nu ain. Lea somá deaivvadit singuin neahta olggobealde, oahpásmuvvat guhtet guimmiideamet, oaidnit sin persovnnalaččat go eanas mis eat leat goasge oaidnán guhtet guimmiideamet ámadajuid, váldit gova maid seailluha ieš ja suddje almmolaččat, bohkosit ovttas ja ságastallat sullasaš beroštumiin ja nu ain. Dat lea somá, sosiála ja liekkus.

Vaikko, áššit eai oro seammalážžat odne. Go olbmot álget geahččalit váldit eret olbmuid anonymitehta, fallehit furriid, therian-olbmuid, LGBTQIA ja doxxet sin, ja go min iežamet searvvuš maid searvá ja bidjá álkidit dramáid sisa, de áššit leat leamaš veahá eanet eahpádusat, unnit liekkus ja unnit dovdomeahttun nugo searvvuš dahje bearaš. Dat ii leat šat seammaláhkai.

Oassi mus sávvá ahte áššit sáhttet máhccat dasa movt dat dovdui 2000- ja 2010-logus, muhto, mun divttán juste Ipmila ordnet loahpa. Mun lean veahá eahpádusas servodaga ja olbmuid hárrái. Mun lean váiban das movt áššit garrasit vearránit ja leat oaivvilduvvon fallehit ja juohkit unna searvvužiid doaivvutmeahttun dilážiidda. Mun in liiko dasa movt servodat ii šat odne gudnejahte ja leat ovttasvuođas.

@doombloomart
I have had US Big Corp required sensitivity training that reminds people not everyone wants alcohol and it's inappropriate to ask why. Seems like that should be more common

I get that with sending random shit to a whole corporation will never be inoffensive to everyone, but 1. don't send random shit to a whole corporation maybe and 2. alcohol just rubs me wrong in the way that many who shouldn't touch it may touch it when it randomly shows up at the doorstep. 😅

source_doc:
Relentless Clan power past Steelers in statement home win

The Clan got off to a strong start with Joe Hazeldine slamming a first-time shot into the Sheffield net after some nice slip passing between Hugo Roy and Deven Sideroff.

Despite some strong defensive play from Glasgow, the Steelers found a breakthrough via Brien Diffley's sharp shooting through traffic before Mikko Juusola gave the visitors the lead with a deflected shot from right wing.

In the second period, the Clan saw momentum swing their way with Steven Seigo slipping a tidy finish from close-range past Matthew Greenfield to tie the game up.

Shortly after, Rylan Schwartz grabbed a go-ahead goal with a bullet from the backdoor after some luck with the Clan avoiding a too many men call.

Sheffield forced their way back into the game with Ryan Tait driving on net and backhanding a shot which Brine saved but didn't keep hold of as Kevin Tansey poked a third goal over the line for the visitors.

With the score line tied going into the final frame, the noise peaked inside Braehead and Glasgow gained control of the game.

Tristin Langan saw retribution for the ongoing battle he had to put up with throughout the game with Mitchell Heard as he cracked the bar with a beautiful finish to give his side the lead.

A holding penalty on Miihkali Teppo applied pressure to the hosts' advantage late on with the Steelers pulling their netminder for the extra attacker.

Langan grabbed his second of the game on the empty net though to round off the night with a well-earned and much-needed two points for the Clan on home ice.

Glasgow Clan head coach, Corey Neilson said after the game: "We were the better team. Our forecheck was excellent, that's something we've worked on all week and it was relentless tonight. The identity we were looking for is starting to show. It was really enjoyable to coach with full lines and take advantage of a team that's playing short, because usually we're on the other side of that."

Sheffield Steelers head coach, Aaron Fox, said: "I thought we were pretty good for the majority of the game. Glasgow jumped on us early, but our bounce back was good. Our guys were gassed by the end, we only had three lines but we were in the battle all game, I can't fault the compete level of our guys."

hypothesis:
Vuordemeahttun Clan válddii nanus ruovttuvuittu Steelersa badjel ja attii nannevaš dieđáhusa.

Clan álggahii spealu hui nanus, go Joe Hazeldine časkii ovttain guoskkahallamiin luoitaga Sheffielda fierpmádahkii maŋŋel čáppa, njulges siskkáldaspassastemiid Hugo Roy ja Deven Sideroff gaskkas.

Vaikko Glasgow čájehii nanu suddjenbarggu, de Steelers gávnnahii ráiggi Brien Diffley dárkkis luoitagiin olbmuid čađa, ovdal go Mikko Juusola attii guossiid johtui bohccon luoitagiin olgeš bealde.

Nuppi bealis fárrii spealu fápmu Clan beallái, go Steven Seigo čuohpai lahka guovllus čáppa loahpahagain Matthew Greenfielda meattá ja dásii bohtosa.

Fargga dan maŋŋel Rylan Schwartz čuohpai ovddidančuoggá garrá luoitagiin maŋábealde, maŋŋel go Clan lihkostuvai garvit ráŋggáštusa badjen spealláriid geažil.

Sheffield bákkihii iežas ruovttoluotta speallui, go Ryan Tait viegai njuni fierpmádaga vuostá ja backhandain luoitii; Brine dorvvastii dan, muhto ii doallán dan, ja Kevin Tansey stohkii guossiid goalmmát čuoggá rastá linnjá.

Go bohtos lei dásis ovdal maŋimuš beali, de jietna badjánii Braeheadas ja Glasgow válddii spealu háldui.

Tristin Langan oaččui mávssu dán joatkevaš gáržžideami ovddas, maid son gillii olles spealu Mitchell Heard vuostá, go son časkii bárrii čáppa loahpahagain ja attii iežas lihttui johtui.

Miihkali Teppo holden-ráŋggáštus dagahii loahpas deattu ruovttulihttui ovdamunni ala, go Steelers válddii fierpmádatvárrejeaddji eret oažžut dihtii lasáčáliheaddji.

Langan čuohpai goit iežas nubbi čuoggá spealus guorus fierpmádahkii, ja dan bokte gidde eahkeda Clan várás bures verdienen ja hui dárbbašlaš guovtti čuoggáin ruovttujiegas.

Glasgow Clan váldovalástalli Corey Neilson celkkii spealu maŋŋel: "Mii leimmet buoret lihttu. Min forecheck lei erenoamáš; dat lea juoga maid leat bargan olles vahku, ja odne eahket dat lei vuordemeahttun. Dat identitehta maid mii leat ohcamin, lea álgán oidnot. Lei duođas somás valáštallat dievas linnjáiguin ja geavahit ávkin dan, ahte vuosttášlihttu speallá unnán olbmuiguin, danne go dábálaččat mii leat dan nuppi bealde."

Sheffield Steelers váldovalástalli Aaron Fox celkkii: "Mun jurddašin ahte mii leimmet hui buorit eanemus oasi spealus. Glasgow bođii min badjelii árrat, muhto min máhccan lei buorre. Min olbmot ledje loahpas hui váiván, mii leimmet dušše golbma linnjá, muhto mii leimmet gilvvus mielde olles spealu. In sáhte moittit min olbmuid gilvalahttinhálu."

source_doc:
Today's Sunday Best features my Knight from Ragnarok Online! This was my very first online PC game, he was an agi/dex 2HQ knight w/ a set of elemental claymores. I played on iRO Loki, and had two drawings featured as loadscreen art!
My online handle stems from this guy. O'Reiley -> Reiley -> Rally

Coming in just under the wire on today's Sunday Best, it's my Deep Rock Galactic Engineer! The loadout I ran most of the time was Executioner LOK-1 & RJ-250 Grenade Launcher. I think the LOK-1 is one of the coolest weapon designs in an FPS, a lock-on mechanic that encouraged finesse & deep mastery.

This week's Sunday Best is my Xenoverse OC, Parma (for parmesan cheese). She had a partner named Brie. Parma dressed up to match the teachers she studied under, but her final fit reflected the one she started with, styled to match this one pair of gloves. She used Giant Storm & Double Sunday a lot.

For my Sunday Best I drew my Paxultek from Remnant II. The goal of my build was to make the damage number from a single shot as large as possible. I used a Widowmaker single-shot elephant rifle we nicknamed The Governor. It was so strong it one-shot teammates through friendly fire damage reduction.

Today's Sunday Best features my funny gay dog lady from Webfishing. Her voice had a deeper, slower pitch so she sounded old & chill. One time I joined a full server, sat somewhere & started posting practical life advice, bits of big-sister wisdom, & the whole server found me & sat with me to listen.

It's Sunday, today's feature is my Darktide Zealot. Her name is Callista, she's chasing sainthood to be pardoned of her many crimes so she won't have to apologize for any of them. She has black dreams full of teeth and is constantly flirting with female Loner Psykers. She's unwell, but Female Loose Cannon Veterans think it's endearing and constantly hit on her for it. Their in-game voices say all of this.

Today's Sunday Best feature is QP from 100% Orange Juice! I played OJ a lot with my fighting game friends; for some reason I'd always have the hand pictured here. We used to post in text chat during games and I'd always say, Do NOT test me. I played so much QP the devs awarded me a special QP badge!

This week's Sunday Best is "Local Psychopath," Fem Boss #1 from Saint's Row 3. This was the first game I wanted to use the create-a-feature to make a character who blended in with the cast and looked like a genuine member of the Third Street Saints. I picked 3 cuz my favorite jacket wasn't in 4. :(

For today's Sunday Best I've got my Animal Crossing Villager to share. My favorite way to play these games is as part of a global cartel of goons who shared their wealth. When one person had big Turnips, everyone got paid. No profiteering; you need a rare item to make your room idea work? We got you.

It's technically Sunday, and this week's fit lands a bit early! I don't Tekken very often, but when I do I like to pick Steve and do all his slippery punches. In Tekken 7 he had a loose-fit, full-body track suit, so I made him into a deer man. When he's in Peekaboo Stance the antlers point forward!

This week's Sunday Best feature is Gaige from Borderlands 2. Pure Anarchy is one of the coolest FPS mechanics in the genre, an escalating accumulation of power that came with a diminishing level of control, lowering both TTK & effective range. Ride the wave & figure it out on the fly, it'll be fine.
Gaige's voice actress plays V in Cyberpunk 2077, I learned recently. An old friend.

Today's Sunday Best isn't a person, it's a plane from an old Vlambeer game called Luftrausers! The music changes to match your airplane. My favorite configuration is called "Shipwreck," a sword-hulled amphibious prop plane with shotgun cannons, it can divebomb through boats & burst up from the sea.

Tonight our Sunday Best feature is the Houndmaster from a charming Crawl-like sidescroller called Vagante. Lovingly referred to as the Dogmancer, I loved to spec into skills that increased damage when you threw the dog at monsters. The dog roams on its own, but you can also carry it on your back!

For this week's Sunday Best we're going all the way back to Cyborg Justice on the Genesis. I played this game a lot and I always liked to make this one guy: round torso, big stampy feet and the buzzsaw hand. I always remember the magazine ad for this game vividly; you might too if you're of an age.

I did a bit of archaeological research to uncover references for this week's Sunday Best. This was my guy from Loadout, a third-person arena shooter about fiddly weapon customization. My main gun was an electric pulse cannon called "Kill-a-Watts" and the backup was a flaming LMG named "Roast Beef."

Mu neahttanamma boahtá dán gánddas. O'Reiley -> Reiley -> Rally

Just ja just fasttain otná Sunday Best -gárvvuin, dás lea mu Deep Rock Galactic Engineer! Eanas áigge mu gárvu lei Executioner LOK-1 ja RJ-250 Grenade Launcher. Mu mielas LOK-1 lea okta somámus vearjominstariin FPS-spealuin, lock-on-mekanihkka mii gáibida čehpoda ja čiekŋalis máhtu.

Dán vahku Sunday Best lea mu Xenoverse OC, Parma (parmesanoastta mielde). Sus lei ustit man namma lei Brie. Parma gárvodii seammaláhkai go su oahpaheaddjit, muhto su maŋimus biktasat muittahedje daid vuosttaš biktasiid, mat ledje hápmejuvvon dán fárttat hanskkaid mielde. Son geavahii ollu Giant Storm ja Double Sunday -fámuid.

Mu Sunday Best -gárvun sárgon mu Paxulteka Remnant II -spealus. Mu buildda ulbmilin lei oažžut ovtta bážáldaga vahága nu stuorran go vejolaš. Geavahin Widowmaker-nammasaš ovttabážáldat elephant-bielkka, man gohčodeimme The Governorin. Dat lei nu fámolaš ahte dat godččii ovttat bážáldagain ustitlaččaid, vaikko friendly fire -vahát lei unniduvvon.

Otná Sunday Best -gárvu lea mu somá homofiila beana-nisu Webfishing-spealus. Su jietna lei jorba ja dásat, nu ahte son gulai boaris ja ráfálaš. Okta háve seahkanin dievva bálvái, čohkkájin gosa nu ja čálligohten praktihkalaš eallinráđiid, boarrásut oappá viisodagaid, ja olles bálvva speallit gávdne mu ja čohkkájedje mu lusa guldalit.

Lea sotnabeaivi, otná gárvu lea mu Darktide Zealot. Su namma lea Callista, son ohcala bassivuođa vai beasá su máŋggaid rihkusain, nu ahte son ii dárbbat addit ándagassii ovttage ovddas. Sus leat čáhppes niegut dievva bániiguin ja son álo flirtte nieida Loner Psykeriiguin. Son ii leat dearvas, muhto Female Loose Cannon Veteránat gávdnet dán somán ja álo geahččalit su vuoitit dán dihte. Spealu jienat muitalit dán buot.

Otná Sunday Best -gárvu lea QP 100% Orange Juice -spealus! Speallen OJ ollu mu dološ ustitlaččaiguin; moadde sivas mus lei álo dát giehta mii lea dás govas. Mii čáliheimmet álo teakstačás spealuid áigge ja mun dappen álo lohkat: "Do NOT test me." Speallen nu ollu QP ahte spealloráhkadeaddjit bálkašedje mu earenoamáš QP-mearkkain!

Dán vahku Sunday Best lea "Local Psychopath", Fem Boss #1 Saint's Row 3 -spealus. Dát lei vuosttaš speallu mas hálidebje geavahit karakteraráhkadanfámu ja ráhkadit karaktera mii heive bures nistái ja lei dego albma Third Street Saints -lahttu. Válljejin 3, go mu liiko-jakká ii lean spealus 4. :(

Otná Sunday Best -gárvui mus lea mu Animal Crossing Villager. Mu eanemus liiko-vuohki speallat dáid spealuid lea dakkár dássegi masiis go ovttas speallit juogadit buot riggodagaid. Go ovttas ledje stuorra Turnips, de buohkat ožžo ruđa. Ii goasge nu ahte okta vuoitá; jus dárbbahat hárvenaš dávvira iežat latnjii? Mii gávdnat dan dutnje.

Tehnikalaččat lea sotnabeaivi, ja dán vahku gárvu boahtá veháš árrat! Mun in speala Tekken nu dávjá, muhto go spealan, de liikon válljet Steve ja dahkat su buot somá hárpmaid. Tekken 7 -spealus sus lei liddas ollesruba-track suit, nu ahte ráhkadin sus bohcco-olbmo. Go son lea Peekaboo Stance -posišuvnnas, de čoarvvit čujuhit ovddosguvlui!

Dán vahku Sunday Best -gárvu lea Gaige Borderlands 2 -spealus. Pure Anarchy lea okta somámus FPS-mekanihkaid dán genre-spealuin, fámolaš lasihus mii buvttii maiddái unnit stivrema, nu ahte unnidii sihke TTK ja dárkilisvuođa. Speala ja gávnna vuogi, dat manná bures.

I just had a very nice #dream that I made friends with Lee Chaeyeon. I just started talking to her nand the next thing I know, I have stayed over her house (like when the French kidnapped me for Christmas) and she is telling me to go up stairs and "shuffle up a little bit" (her English was generally excellent) by which she meant "tidy up a little bit" to show her mom we were ready to eat.
She comes upstairs to "shuffle up" her room and starts making gestures to explain what she means ...
1/

(she was always so excited to see me in this dream) because I was taking my coat off instead of "shuffling up."
Then she indicates this little piece of paper and says she has left me an autograph but in return she wants this little trading card I made in second grade of "50 Spikes," a sonic knock-off, obviously with more spikes. (This card actually exists IRL BTW). I start explaining to her what it is and if she really wants it (she did) I at least needed a picture of her holding it.
2/

Partly because I would miss it, but also, otherwise no one would believe me that she had wanted this thing from me.
It was then I realized we still didn't have each others' phone numbers.
3/3
